headline: Bytedance introduces Seedream 5.5, an image model for production work
body: According to Bytedance, Seedream 5.5 has stable multi-round editing across up to 100 rounds, with unchanged image areas preserved at the pixel level and no color shifts. It also generates native RGBA images with transparent backgrounds. A Pro version is planned.
note: The gains are in image editing and design assets, which design and marketing teams are likelier to use first than finance teams.

evidence.text: Bytedance Seed introduces Seedream 5.5, a new image generation model built for professional production workflows.
According to Bytedance, one improvement is stable multi-round editing across up to 100 rounds, with unchanged image areas preserved at the pixel level and no color shifts.
Seedream 5.5 also generates native RGBA images with transparent backgrounds, letting generated elements serve directly as design assets without manual cutouts.
